# Delivery undertaking

**Recipient:** ⟦PERSON|Inelle Marrowen⟧

**Delivering firm:** ⟦ORG|Wisp Spoke Logistics LLP⟧ (the Firm)

1. The Firm undertakes to deliver the sealed archive boxes to the address recorded below.

| Delivery field | Recorded value |
| --- | --- |
| Street and locality | ⟦ADDRESS|27 Wisp Lane<br>Norwich NR2 8ZZ⟧ |
| Notification email | ⟦EMAIL|inelle.delivery@wisp-spoke.invalid⟧ |

2. Delivery may be accepted only after the number of boxes has been checked against the inventory. The recipient is not required to open the boxes on the pavement or to confirm the condition of documents that cannot reasonably be inspected at that time.

3. If access is unavailable, the driver must contact the recipient before returning the boxes to storage. Leaving them with an unidentified neighbouring occupier is outside this undertaking. An attempted delivery does not by itself create an additional storage charge.

**Acknowledgement:** ⟦PERSON|Inelle Marrowen⟧[^3]

[^3]: An acknowledgement confirms receipt of the undertaking. It does not record delivery of the boxes or waive any claim concerning missing contents.

The delivery window is 09:00–12:00 on 24 November 2026. The agreed price is GBP 110, with no weekend surcharge.
